messages:
Ravi M: Publish blocked: release/v0.43.0 failed changelog validation (no fragment). saw release-bot log: 'aborted due to regendiff'.

Clara W: Ah, I accidentally pushed a semver tag from my laptop but didn't run `yarn regen`. The typegen diff is tiny (prop ordering), but regendiff job returns non-zero so bot won't create fragment.

release-bot: could not create changelog fragment 1: regendiff-check failed. See CI job: `typegen/regendiff`.

Diego: Quick workaround: add a manual fragment and rerun CI. But note there's a flaky sample-app test around auth retry that often times out on the release runner. If CI flakes we'll be stuck again.

Ravi M: Can we at least have the bot post the regendiff summary so authors know what to regen? Right now it's just 'regendiff failed' with no details.

Clara W: I ran `yarn regen` locally and saw the ordering diff. It doesn't change runtime behavior. I'll push a regen commit + changelog fragment. Steps: `yarn regen && git commit -am "chore(typegen): regen for v0.43.0" && echo "- devex: fix missing changelog fragment" > changelog/fragments/0002.md && git add changelog/fragments/0002.md && git push`.

QA-bot: FYI theres a known flaky test: tests/sample-app/auth-retry.test.js has intermittent network timing on CI containers. We've muted it on the nightly pipeline but release pipeline still runs it.

Diego: For this release, can we @ci-admin to rerun the job if it flakes? Also, maybe add a short prerelease checklist to the release job: run `yarn regen` and compare regendiff output locally.

release-bot: publish pipeline retriggered by push from Clara W. Tag job queued.

Ravi M: After this goes green we should file two tiny follow-ups: (1) make release-bot attach regendiff summary (whitelisted globs only) and (2) change publish CI to retry flaky sample-app tests twice before failing the whole job. I'll draft the RFC today.

Clara W: Pushed the commits, ci shows green for typegen/regendiff but sample-app test failed once on the first run and passed on retry. Rerun succeeded, publish completed. Thanks all. :tada:
